# Pranav Pahuja — pranavpahuja.com

> Strategy & Digital Transformation Consultant with 6+ years at Deloitte Consulting USI. Specialises in AI-enabled operations, enterprise architecture, Oracle integration systems, and Python automation for Fortune 500 clients across retail, consumer, public services, and healthcare.

## About

Pranav Pahuja is a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting USI based in Gurugram, India. He works at the intersection of enterprise technology and business strategy — designing transformation roadmaps, deploying AI and automation platforms, and translating complex technical programs into executive-level business outcomes.

Key achievements:
- 300+ hours/month saved across 40+ automation solutions (alerts, monitoring, data syncing, reporting)
- 99.9% error reduction across mission-critical production systems
- ~80% reduction in production failures for a Fortune 500 US retailer (Kroger)
- Ranked 3rd out of 134 practitioners in Deloitte's AI Academy (9-month program)
- Led teams of 5+ consultants; coordinated 20+ global cross-functional teams

## Expertise
